# Release v3.4.4

<!-- Generated by cidx on 2026-09-24 09:02 -->
<!-- Edit this file to customize your release notes -->

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **generate:** keep emitted action versions current, and report ageing ones as drift (#491)

  `cidx generate github` now writes `actions/checkout@v7` and
  `actions/setup-go@v7` (they were a major behind), and a test keeps the
  generator level with the versions Dependabot maintains in this repository.
  `cidx check drift` reports a generated action your workflow runs a major
  behind, with the command to regenerate it — the generated workflow is the one
  file a Dependabot bump cannot keep current, since the next
  `cidx generate --force` reverts it (#424).

- **release:** keep cidx plumbing out of the notes and the committed notes in the tree (#490)

  `release prepare` no longer lists the empty "initialize PR branch" commit
  (#488), and `release create` no longer deletes committed release notes on
  cleanup, which left `main` with an unstaged deletion after a release (#489).
